title: fix(incremental): resolve asset placeholders in modules or compiled CSS
body:
## Changes

- Resolves asset placeholders before hashing compiled CSS, preventing unchanged pages from being rebuilt.
- Adds support for Rolldown’s `import.meta.ROLLDOWN_FILE_URL_*` asset references.

## Testing

- Adds coverage confirming hashes stay stable when Rolldown assigns different handles to the same assets.
- Adds coverage confirming compiled CSS asset-handle changes do not trigger unnecessary rebuilds.

## Docs

N/a — fixes expected behavior

Closes #18058
